title: CE20103: Transportation Engg.
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Roadway Alignment; Geometric Design of Highways: cross-sectional elements,
horizontal and vertical alignments; Elements of Traffic Engineering;
Introduction to Railways and Airports; Pavement Materials: subgrade soil,
aggregates, bituminous and modified binders; Elements of Construction:
embankment, soil stabilisation, non-bituminous and bituminous subbase and base
courses, bituminous surface courses, concrete pavements; Fundamentals of
Pavement Design; Drainage, evaluation and maintenance of highways.
